title: Sabulun hannu da na kwanoni ta tsarin kashi

say: Sabulun Ruwa na Wanke Hannu da na Wanke Kwanoni ta Tsarin Kashi. Wannan shi ne babi na 2 na kwas ɗin.
Yau za ki haɗa sabulun hannu mai laushi a bokiti, ki ƙara masa kauri ba tare da ɓata shi ba, ki kuma zaɓi sabulun kwanoni ta ainihin ƙirga faranti.

shots.label: Aunawa ta kashi

card.title: Tsarin farko na sabulun hannu
card.note: Da EDTA 0.1%, turare 0.4%, citric acid yadda ake buƙata

say: Duk abin da kika gani yana hawa wannan ma'auni ana auna shi ne a matsayin kashi na haɗin duka.
Ta haka takarda ɗaya tana aiki don gwajin kilogiram 2 ko haɗin kilogiram 200. Ninkawa kawai za ki yi.
Wannan tsarin farko ne don haɗin gwaji. Sinadari mai aiki ya kai 9.9%, matsakaicin adadi ga hannaye.

card.title: Haɗin Chiamaka na 10 kg
card.note: EDTA 10 g, preservative 80 g, turare 40 g

say: Chiamaka a Enugu tana son kilogiram 10, kusan kwalabe 20 na mililita 500. Ta ninka kowane kashi da giram 10,000, ta raba da 100.
Sannan ta haɗa kowane layi don tabbatar ya kai giram 10,000 daidai, ta kuma yi wa kowane nauyi alama yayin da take zubawa.

shots.label: Safar hannu da gilashin ido
say: Ki saka safar hannu da gilashin kariya kafin ki buɗe kwaɓin SLES ko man turare. Duka biyun suna iya ɓata fata da ido.

shots.label: Ruwa, EDTA, sannan kwaɓin SLES
say: Ga ganga mai tsabta. Ki auna ruwan, ki ajiye kusan 10% don daga baya, ki juya EDTA a ciki har ya narke.
Yanzu kwaɓin SLES yana shiga, guntu-guntu, yayin da muciya ke tafiya a hankali. Ki juya a hankali don kada ki tayar da kumfar iska.
Idan ya yi santsi babu dunƙule, ki ƙara CAPB da gilisarin ki juya har ya daidaita.

shots.label: Turare an fara haɗa shi da CAPB
say: Ki kalli ɗigon. Ki fara haɗa turaren da ɗan CAPB, don kada sabulun hannun ya yi dushi.
Sannan ki ƙara preservative da kowane launi.

shots.label: Gwajin pH bayan minti 15
say: Ki bar shi ya huta na minti 15, sannan ki tsoma takardar gwaji. Kina son kusan 5.5 zuwa 6.5.
Idan ya yi sama, ki saukar da shi da ruwan citric acid, ta samfur tukuna, daidai yadda kika koya a babi na 1.

shots.label: Samfurori huɗu na 200 g

card.title: Gwajin gishiri na Ruth
card.note: Lokacin gudu daga sirinji, alamar 50 ml zuwa 10 ml

say: Gishiri yana ƙara kauri har zuwa ƙoli, sannan ruwan ya sake yin tsululu, kuma ba za ki iya cire gishiri ba.
Don haka Ruth a Jos ta auna samfurori huɗu na giram 200, ta saka wa kowanne gishiri daban.
Kauri ya tashi har 1.5%, ya faɗi a 2.0%. Ƙolinta yana kusa da 1.5%, wanda ya dace da buƙatarta ta daƙiƙa 15 zuwa 25.

shots.label: An zuba gishiri a narke a ruwa
shots.banner: Gishiri a ƙarshe, bayan pH, kashi-kashi
say: Yanzu ki kalli yadda yake yin kauri. Ruth ta narkar da gishirinta giram 300 a cikin giram 1,200 na ruwan da ta ajiye, ta yi ruwan gishiri na 20%.
Ta zuba shi kashi uku, tana juyawa tana gwaji bayan kowanne. Haɗin ya kai kusan daƙiƙa 20 ba tare da ya wuce ƙoli ba.

shots.label: Ya kwana yana hutawa, sannan a cika
say: Ki bar haɗin a rufe ya kwana don kumfar iska ta tashi. Sannan ki duba shi da buƙatunki da samfurinki na misali, ki cika kwalabe.
Haɗin da ya kasa ana riƙe shi a gyara, ba a taɓa sayar da shi don ya kusa kyau ba.
Sabulun kwanoni yana da aiki mafi wuya. A littafinta, Zainab a Kano ta gwada tsari biyu iri ɗaya: giram 2 na mai a kowane faranti, lita 5 na ruwan ɗumi, zubin mililita 5.
Ta wanke har kumfa ya ƙare, ta ƙirga faranti. Tsari A ya fi tsada a kowace lita amma ya fi araha a kowane faranti, kuma ya fi na kasuwa. Ta zaɓi A.

shots.label: pH na sabulun kwanoni kusan 6 zuwa 8
say: Ki gwada sabulun kwanonin ma. Ki riƙe shi kusan 6 zuwa 8, mai laushi ga hannayen da ke daɗewa cikin ruwa.
Kada ki taɓa ƙara kostik soda ko soda ash don ƙarin ƙarfi. Yana ɓata fata kuma yana iya dusashe tukwanen aluminiyam.

shots.label: Kwalaben sabulu na ainihi
shots.banner: Kada ki zuba sabulun kwanoni a kwalbar lemo
say: Dubi waɗannan kwalabe a kan tebur: kwalaben sabulu na ainihi masu rubutu.
Kada ki taɓa amfani da tsofaffin kwalaben lemo ko na ruwa. Wani zai iya sha daga ciki. Ki buga "A ajiye nesa da yara" da layin taimakon gaggawa.

shots.label: Ruwan launi na 1%

card.title: Launi da lissafi
rows: Abin da ake so a 20 kg
Ruwan launin da za a auna

say: Launukan kwalliya suna da ƙarfi sosai, don haka ki yi ruwan launi na 1% ki riƙa zuba shi maimakon haka.
Idan wani abu ya lalace, ki canza abu ɗaya kawai a kowane samfurin gwaji ki rubuta shi.
Yanzu ki bi darussan da ke ƙasa. Ki yi haɗin gwajinki na kilogiram 2, ki yi gwajin faranti naki, ki zana layin gishirinki. Lambobinki ne za su nuna miki abin da ke aiki.
